name: 7. Dark Web Threat Intelligence
description: Investigate dark web exposure from a defensive and threat-intelligence perspective: map leaked footprints, monitor for compromised credentials, recognize illicit marketplaces, source intelligence responsibly, trace cryptocurrency flows, and watch forums for early warning, all within legal authorization.

stages.stageText: A logistics client wants to know what an outside observer can already learn about them from leaked and indexed sources before attackers do. Map the organization's exposed footprint, stay inside the authorized intelligence brief, and turn the observation into a defensive finding.

answers: It proves the company is actively being attacked right now.
It shows what employee, infrastructure, and document details are already exposed and could seed targeted attacks.
It is only useful for marketing analytics.
It guarantees the network has already been breached.
stages.incorrectAnswerText: Look for the option that connects exposed information to realistic attacker advantage and a defensive response.
stages.stageText: Why does dark web footprinting matter for defenders?

options.optionText: Catalogue exposed identifiers, link them to owners, and flag the riskiest leaks for remediation under the agreed brief.
Contact the leak sources directly and try to buy the data back to look thorough.

stages.stageText: The client needs a next step. Which response best preserves evidence and reduces risk?
Add this case location to the threat map so the report links the exposed footprint to the affected business.
Good work. You turned scattered leaks into a scoped exposure picture and a defensive action. Unlock Exposure Footprinting before the next intelligence case.

A retail client suspects staff passwords appear in old breach collections circulating on hidden sites. Your authorized task is to confirm exposure so accounts can be protected, not to reuse any credential. Stay inside the brief and turn the observation into a defensive finding.

answers: To identify which accounts are exposed so they can be reset and protected before misuse.
To log in as employees and verify the passwords personally.
To publish the password list as proof of the finding.
To sell the verified credentials to the highest bidder.
stages.incorrectAnswerText: Look for the option that keeps the goal defensive: protect the exposed accounts, never use them.
stages.stageText: What is the legitimate purpose of monitoring for leaked credentials?

options.optionText: Match exposed credentials to current accounts, trigger forced resets, and recommend MFA for affected logins.
Try the leaked passwords against live accounts to see how many still work.

stages.stageText: The client needs a next step. Which response best preserves evidence and reduces risk?
Add this case location to the threat map so the report links the credential exposure to the affected accounts.
Good work. You confirmed exposure and routed it into resets and MFA instead of misuse. Unlock Credential Exposure Monitoring before the next intelligence case.

A brand-protection client reports counterfeit goods and stolen account bundles being advertised on hidden marketplaces. You are authorized to identify and document these listings for takedown and law-enforcement referral, not to transact. Stay inside the brief and turn the observation into a defensive finding.

answers: To shop for discounted stolen goods.
To recognize where the client's data or brand is being traded so abuse can be reported and disrupted.
To prove that all hidden services are illegal.
To advertise the investigator's own services.
stages.incorrectAnswerText: Look for the option that frames marketplace identification as reporting and disruption, not participation.
stages.stageText: Why does a defender identify illicit marketplaces?

options.optionText: Document listing details, capture verifiable evidence, and route it to takedown and law-enforcement channels.
Make a test purchase with client funds to confirm the seller is real.

stages.stageText: The client needs a next step. Which response best preserves evidence and reduces risk?
Add this case location to the threat map so the report links the marketplace activity to the affected brand.
Good work. You documented illicit listings for disruption instead of engaging with them. Unlock Marketplace Identification before the next intelligence case.

An energy-sector client wants early warning about threats aimed at their industry, drawn from chatter across hidden sites. The value is only as good as the sourcing. Stay inside the brief and turn raw chatter into reliable, defensible intelligence.

answers: It records the source, date, reliability, and context so claims can be assessed instead of assumed true.
It treats every post as confirmed fact to save time.
It only keeps the most alarming screenshots.
It hides where the information came from to protect the report.
stages.incorrectAnswerText: Look for the option that makes intelligence verifiable: sourcing, dating, and reliability over raw alarm.
stages.stageText: What separates usable threat intelligence from rumor?

options.optionText: Tag each item with source, timestamp, and a reliability rating, then correlate before alerting the client.
Forward every unverified threat claim straight to the client as an emergency.

stages.stageText: The client needs a next step. Which response best preserves evidence and reduces risk?
Add this case location to the threat map so the report links the intelligence to the affected sector.
Good work. You turned noise into sourced, rated intelligence the client can act on. Unlock Threat Intelligence Sourcing before the next intelligence case.

A finance client paid an extortion demand and wants to understand where the cryptocurrency went, working with law enforcement. You are authorized to analyze public blockchain records, not to interact with any wallet. Stay inside the brief and turn the flow into a defensive finding.

answers: Public ledgers let investigators trace transaction flows and cluster related addresses for attribution.
Cryptocurrency is fully anonymous, so tracing is impossible.
Investigators must control the wallets to read the ledger.
Only the exchange can ever see any transaction.
stages.incorrectAnswerText: Look for the option that reflects how public blockchains enable tracing rather than guaranteeing anonymity.
stages.stageText: What makes cryptocurrency tracing possible for investigators?

options.optionText: Trace the public transaction path, cluster related addresses, and hand the analysis to law enforcement and the exchange.
Send a small payment to the attacker's wallet to test which exchange it reaches.

stages.stageText: The client needs a next step. Which response best preserves evidence and reduces risk?
Add this case location to the threat map so the report links the transaction trail to the affected client.
Good work. You followed the public trail and routed it to the right authorities instead of engaging the wallet. Unlock Cryptocurrency Tracing before the next intelligence case.

A healthcare client wants advance warning if their systems become a target of discussion on closed forums. You are authorized to observe and report, not to participate or provoke. Stay inside the brief and turn forum signals into a defensive finding.

answers: To join the conversation and steer attackers away from the client.
To detect early signals, such as the client being named or new techniques emerging, so defenses can be prepared.
To prove the forum members are committing crimes by entrapping them.
To collect as many usernames as possible for a public list.
stages.incorrectAnswerText: Look for the option that keeps the role passive and defensive: observe early signals, do not participate or entrap.
stages.stageText: What is the defensive value of monitoring dark web forums?

options.optionText: Passively record relevant threads, preserve evidence, and brief the client so they can harden the named systems.
Post replies to bait members into revealing more about their plans.

stages.stageText: The client needs a next step. Which response best preserves evidence and reduces risk?
Add this case location to the threat map so the report links the forum chatter to the affected systems.
Good work. You stayed an observer and converted early chatter into preparation time for the client. Unlock Forum Threat Monitoring to complete the unit.
